topic: ML model data extraction and format
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on extracting ML model data. Initially, the plan was to pull data from PostgreSQL (PG) or ClickHouse (CH). It was determined that mapping the `model_columns` array of strings into CH proved difficult.

Instead, a JSON format approach was implemented and shared. The resulting data structure is available in CH as a string, which can be processed using Python.

The extracted data includes model details such as company ID, model type, model name, and category.
decisions: ML model data will be extracted into JSON format for easier processing.
action_items: Someone needs to process the JSON data structure in Python.
